meta.note: Mining autonomy is a first-class domain: private geofenced ODDs on mine roads are South Africa's most controllable environments and the most practice-ready autonomy market. Site facts are public-record knowledge; automation claims marked for verification.

thesis: Mine roads are private, geofenced, low-speed, and fleet-controlled. This is where SA can build real autonomy operations today without any public-road legal change, and where global autonomous haulage technology (Caterpillar MineStar, Komatsu AHS/FrontRunner, Epiroc, Sandvik AutoMine) already operates elsewhere. Skill/technology migration from mining autonomy into road autonomy is a leading indicator to monitor.
